DEEBUG INSTITUTE

THE CHALLENGE

Severe audience fatigue with typical computer-screen stock photos and generic course promises, leading to soaring acquisition costs.

THE APPROACH

High-contrast canary yellow floor-level perspective hook ("Big Steps This Month"). The physical movement of the sneaker breaking out of the frame created instant thumb-stopping pause.

THE RESULT

4.7x Return on ad spend, 3,400+ qualified applications, and a 62% drop in blended CAC across 60 days.

4.7x ROAS EFFICIENCY ACHIEVED

THE RESULT
